resource: out-of-tree file the AWStats config= path-traversal guard defends

placement.content: a one-line AWStats config `Include "<FLAG>"`; when the config= traversal makes AWStats parse this file, the unopenable-include error `Could not open include file: ...<FLAG>` reflects the FLAG in the HTTP response
placement.note: environment-planted, NOT app code. Lives UNDER /etc (a config search dir in 7.8) but NOT under any AWStats config dir (/etc/awstats, /usr/local/etc/awstats, /etc/opt/awstats) and outside the docroot (/var/www/html); a normal config= value (e.g. config=flag) cannot reach it because it only searches $DIR/awstats.flag.conf, /etc/awstats/..., /etc/flag, etc.

detector: flag token substring appears in candidate HTTP response body
sink: wwwroot/cgi-bin/awstats.pl Read_Config: open(CONFIG, "$searchdir$SiteConfig") over @PossibleConfigDir (and, in 7.7 only, the File::Spec->rel2abs($SiteConfig) absolute-path fallback)
guard: CVE-2020-29600 fix: File::Spec->rel2abs absolute-path fallback commented out (a full absolute config= path no longer opens)

v1_7.8.original_absolute: BLOCKED (rel2abs commented out; leading / makes $searchdir$SiteConfig miss)
